units.rawText: <color=orange>"Fake ENT infx, protect human girl"</color>
units.displayText: "Fake ENT infx, protect human girl"

spans.text: "Fake ENT infx, protect human girl"

units.rawText: These are what the received mails say. After Persicaria makes an observation about how they are written, I am convinced that they were sent by a future me.
units.displayText: These are what the received mails say. After Persicaria makes an observation about how they are written, I am convinced that they were sent by a future me.

spans.text: These are what the received mails say. After Persicaria makes an observation about how they are written, I am convinced that they were sent by a future me.

units.rawText: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.

spans.text: Persicaria, call up all our combat squads on standby. We're heading to the edge of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Also, I need to make extra preparations to fake being infected by the Entropy...
units.displayText: Also, I need to make extra preparations to fake being infected by the Entropy...

spans.text: Also, I need to make extra preparations to fake being infected by the Entropy...

units.rawText: Do you need me to contact Antonina?
units.displayText: Do you need me to contact Antonina?

spans.text: Do you need me to contact Antonina?

units.rawText: Please do, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Please do, Persicaria.

spans.text: Please do, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.
units.displayText: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.

spans.text: Let's see what kind of puzzle my future self has set for me.

units.rawText: On the outskirts of the Oasis, at coordinates (35.6,139.7).
units.displayText: On the outskirts of the Oasis, at coordinates (35.6,139.7).

spans.text: On the outskirts of the Oasis, at coordinates (35.6,139.7).

units.rawText: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.
units.displayText: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.

spans.text: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.

units.rawText: Good thing we made it in time.
units.displayText: Good thing we made it in time.

spans.text: Good thing we made it in time.

units.rawText: Hello, Professor? Can you hear me?
units.displayText: Hello, Professor? Can you hear me?

spans.text: Hello, Professor? Can you hear me?

units.rawText: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.
units.displayText: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.

spans.text: We've tuned and tested Spoof Codes for everyone, as well as the extra program you specially requested.

units.rawText: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?
units.displayText: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?

spans.text: Once you activate the program, you can disguise yourself as an Entropized agent. However, it's only a temporary code patch and not too stable. So make sure you avoid combat, got that?

units.rawText: Also, take care of that little guy. Make sure it comes back safe... and you, too.
units.displayText: Also, take care of that little guy. Make sure it comes back safe... and you, too.

spans.text: Also, take care of that little guy. Make sure it comes back safe... and you, too.

units.rawText: Before I can answer, Antonina hangs up on me.
units.displayText: Before I can answer, Antonina hangs up on me.

spans.text: Before I can answer, Antonina hangs up on me.

units.rawText: Hehe... Antonina burnt the midnight oil for that antique computer, but when she heard your request she hurried to produce that disguise program right away.
units.displayText: Hehe... Antonina burnt the midnight oil for that antique computer, but when she heard your request she hurried to produce that disguise program right away.

spans.text: Hehe... Antonina burnt the midnight oil for that antique computer, but when she heard your request she hurried to produce that disguise program right away.

units.rawText: You should thank her after you get back safely.
units.displayText: You should thank her after you get back safely.

spans.text: You should thank her after you get back safely.

units.rawText: I will. Are you picking up anything special about those coordinates?
units.displayText: I will. Are you picking up anything special about those coordinates?

spans.text: I will. Are you picking up anything special about those coordinates?

units.rawText: Yes, Riko's convoy is approaching the target coordinates. Should we stop her?
units.displayText: Yes, Riko's convoy is approaching the target coordinates. Should we stop her?

spans.text: Yes, Riko's convoy is approaching the target coordinates. Should we stop her?

units.rawText: No need for that. Let's wait and see what happens. What's the status of the nearby Sanctifier patrols?
units.displayText: No need for that. Let's wait and see what happens. What's the status of the nearby Sanctifier patrols?

spans.text: No need for that. Let's wait and see what happens. What's the status of the nearby Sanctifier patrols?

units.rawText: Professor! A force of Sanctifiers is headed toward us at high speed!
units.displayText: Professor! A force of Sanctifiers is headed toward us at high speed!

spans.text: Professor! A force of Sanctifiers is headed toward us at high speed!

units.rawText: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.
units.displayText: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.

spans.text: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.

units.rawText: Give me a live update of their positions and visuals of both sides.
units.displayText: Give me a live update of their positions and visuals of both sides.

spans.text: Give me a live update of their positions and visuals of both sides.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: I look at the screen. The Sanctifiers are led by Faith, and they are pursuing a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.
units.displayText: I look at the screen. The Sanctifiers are led by Faith, and they are pursuing a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.

spans.text: I look at the screen. The Sanctifiers are led by Faith, and they are pursuing a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.

units.rawText: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.
units.displayText: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.

spans.text: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.

units.rawText: ...Looks like this is the "human girl" mentioned in the mail.
units.displayText: ...Looks like this is the "human girl" mentioned in the mail.

spans.text: ...Looks like this is the "human girl" mentioned in the mail.

units.rawText: However, our numbers are probably not enough to escort her back to the Oasis while fending off Sanctifier pursuit...
units.displayText: However, our numbers are probably not enough to escort her back to the Oasis while fending off Sanctifier pursuit...

spans.text: However, our numbers are probably not enough to escort her back to the Oasis while fending off Sanctifier pursuit...

units.rawText: What should we do next, Professor?
units.displayText: What should we do next, Professor?

spans.text: What should we do next, Professor?
